svg.aria-label: How it works: 1. Write with /sdd-planner:write, picking one of 2 or 3 drafts, one section per turn. 2. Review with /sdd-planner:review, approving each part or marking it Needs changes; Claude fixes flagged parts and marks them Re-check. 3. Publish with /sdd-planner:publish: lint, bump the version, and sync to Notion if it is on.
